(The Black and Whites) | founded = {{Start date and age|2012}}{{cite web | url = https://www.nzs.si/tekmovanja/?action=vsiKlubi&id_menu=35 | title = Klubi |trans-title=Clubs | publisher = [[Football Association of Slovenia]] | access-date = 29 July 2016 | language = sl }} | ground = [[Fazanerija City Stadium|Fazanerija]] | capacity = 4,506 | chrtitle = President | chairman = Robert Kuzmič | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Mitja Mörec]] | league = [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]] | season = [[2025–26 Slovenian PrvaLiga|2025–26]] | position = Slovenian PrvaLiga, 8th of 10 | pattern_la1 = _adidasstriped24wb | pattern_b1 = _adidasstriped24wb | pattern_ra1 = _adidasstriped24wb | pattern_sh1 = _adidastiro24wb | pattern_so1 = _adidasblackl | leftarm1 = | body1 = | rightarm1 = | shorts1 = | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _adidassquadra25bw | pattern_b2 = _adidassquadra25bw | pattern_ra2 = _adidassquadra25bw | pattern_sh2 = _adidassquadra25bw | pattern_so2 = _adidaswhitel | leftarm2 = | body2 = | rightarm2 = | shorts2 = | socks2 = 000000 | website = {{URL|https://www.nsmura.si/}} }} '''Nogometna šola Mura''' ({{langx|en|Mura Football School}}), commonly referred to as '''NŠ Mura''' or simply '''Mura''', is a Slovenian professional [[Association football|football]] club from [[Murska Sobota]]. Founded in 2012, the team currently plays in the [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]], the top tier of Slovenian football. The club's home ground is [[Fazanerija City Stadium]] with a capacity of 4,506 seats. The club started competing in the fourth tier of Slovenian football in 2013, and was promoted to the top flight by 2018. In 2020, Mura won its first major trophy after winning the [[Slovenian Football Cup|Slovenian national cup]]. A year later, they became the champions of the Slovenian top division. Nicknamed the "Black and Whites" ([[Prekmurje Slovene]]: ''Čarno-bejli''), they play their home games in black-and-white striped kits."}}
